purpose: Expose the SEIS specialist lanes and SEIS Store through one local-first, source-backed Command Center control plane.
runtimeBoundary: This registry renders local source evidence and browser-local demo entry points. It does not authenticate connectors, execute MCP tools, install packages, deploy cloud resources, execute SSH, or mutate GitHub.

pluginUniverse.coreBinding: SEIS Core renders the submitted plugin universe and capability-lane totals while activation remains task-scoped, authenticated, least-privilege, and human-approved.

store.contract: SEIS Store records catalog and install state in browser-local storage only.
store.approvalBoundary: It does not download packages, install dependencies, call external services, or approve remote actions.

lanes.label: SEIS
lanes.coreBinding: SEIS Core owns the visible operating map and routes governed work through the unified SEIS-Agent contract.
lanes.role: Repository governance, architecture, documentation, quality, and ecosystem coordination.
lanes.storeBinding: The Store catalogs the unified agent as one published plugin rather than a standalone lane install.

lanes.label: SEIS Cloud
lanes.coreBinding: SEIS Core exposes provider preflight, rollback, and approval facts without claiming a live cloud connection.
lanes.role: Cloud readiness, public cloud planning, team VPN cloud planning, SSH boundaries, rollback, and secret-safe infrastructure work.
lanes.storeBinding: The Store can surface Cloud as a local demo item; provider activation remains separately approved.

lanes.label: SEIS Code
lanes.coreBinding: SEIS Core binds implementation, validation, and plugin engineering work to the Code lane and its visible quality gate.
lanes.role: Architecture-aware implementation, tests, CI, MCP and plugin code, and repository automation.
lanes.storeBinding: The Store exposes the browser-local Code surface without claiming host-shell or package installation access.

lanes.label: SEIS Design
lanes.coreBinding: SEIS Core keeps design-system, accessibility, motion, and visual-QA work visible beside its implementation and evidence boundaries.
lanes.role: Premium product design, UI and UX systems, accessibility, motion, and visual QA.
lanes.storeBinding: The Store exposes Design as a local product surface, not a remote design-tool integration claim.

lanes.label: SEIS Data
lanes.coreBinding: SEIS Core uses Data to govern schemas, reports, memory, provenance, and safe knowledge intake before automation expands.
lanes.role: Data architecture, analytics, generated reports, schemas, memory, context, RAG planning, and provenance.
lanes.storeBinding: The Store catalogs Data-facing local experiences without exporting private datasets or connector credentials.

lanes.label: SEIS Store
lanes.coreBinding: SEIS Core treats the Store as the local catalog and install-state surface for apps, plugins, themes, tools, and specialist-lane discovery.
lanes.role: Browser-local app, plugin, theme, tool, install, update, and enable state catalog.
lanes.storeBinding: This lane is the catalog authority for browser-local Store state; it has no remote installer or MCP execution path.
